note: Committed coordination snapshot, not a live sync. F01-F04 are implemented in an open PR and are In Review, not released. Owners/dates unset until real.

items.title: Establish product plan and audit baseline
items.scope: Maintain the corrected scope, assumptions, task plan and evidence policy.
items.acceptance: A contributor can locate the accepted objective, source snapshot, constraints and roadmap without conversation history.

linear.title: F01 · Establish product plan and audit baseline

items.title: Deliver protected linear-light region composition
items.scope: Compose aligned passes with explicit masks, confidence and exact protection.
items.acceptance: Shape/range errors fail closed; unknown confidence preserves base; fully protected output bytes equal base; overlap and linear-light tests pass.

linear.title: F02 · Deliver protected linear-light region composition

items.title: Deliver aligned-pass CLI and reproducibility recipe
items.scope: Export verified reblends without another inference call.
items.acceptance: CLI validates inputs/masks, prevents source overwrite, verifies encoded PNG and records resolved parameters and unsigned hashes.

linear.title: F03 · Deliver aligned-pass CLI and reproducibility recipe

items.title: Persist versioned artifacts with storage budgets
items.scope: Keep saved jobs, masks and recipes through process restart with bounded composition.
items.acceptance: Restart, checksum, concurrent revision, rollback and storage-budget tests pass; limitations distinguish stripe allowance from measured total RSS.

linear.title: F04 · Persist versioned artifacts with storage budgets

items.title: Qualify installed runtimes and select a precision base
items.scope: Audit actual capabilities and audition checksum-pinned candidates on target hardware.
items.acceptance: At least one selected base has real output, actual weight/runtime hashes and terms, target-device resource evidence and visual fidelity review. Availability alone does not pass.

linear.title: F05 · Qualify installed runtimes and select a precision base

items.title: Qualify one live compatible texture workflow
items.scope: Promote one SDXL/Clarity-style texture workflow through the local adapter.
items.acceptance: Live worker run with actual compatible weights/nodes/seed, exact dimensions and documented registration, output evidence and quality review; mocked HTTP is insufficient.

linear.title: F06 · Qualify one live compatible texture workflow

items.title: Implement durable async jobs and scoped cancellation
items.scope: Extend existing run identity/reconciliation into a bounded async worker and cancellation path.
items.acceptance: Requests stay responsive; restart and cancel outcomes are scoped to the owned job; unknown submission cannot trigger duplicate generation; no global interruption of unrelated work.
items.evidence: fidelis/studio/comfy.py; docs/COMFY_TEXTURE_BACKEND.md; F07-A bounded worker/local cancellation protocol-tested in PR #12; live acceptance remains open

linear.title: F07 · Implement durable async jobs and scoped cancellation

items.title: Accept editable regional review and native-pixel inspection
items.scope: Complete acceptance of painted masks, brush tools, revision saves, preview and actual native-pixel inspection.
items.acceptance: Mouse/pen/touch/keyboard and stale edits verified on real browser/device; native 100/200% crops distinguish source pixels from preview zoom; no mask protection regression.
items.evidence: fidelis/studio/studio.html; editor.js; brush.py; tests/test_region_brush.py; F08-A native crops/paired inspector protocol and DOM tested in PR #12; F08-B device acceptance remains open

linear.title: F08 · Accept editable regional review and native-pixel inspection

items.title: Qualify confidence-gated automatic segmentation
items.scope: Suggest editable semantic masks using cleared actual model candidates.
items.acceptance: Actual labels and terms verified; annotated collars/cuffs/hair and product cases evaluated; unknown regions stay protected; full-resolution refinement fits measured resources.
items.evidence: fidelis/studio/suggestions.py; store.py staging/review; scripts/mask-suggestion.py; tests/test_mask_suggestions.py; actual model/label/terms/ROI/resource qualification pending; docs/project/checkpoints/2026-11-10-mask-suggestions.md

linear.title: F09 · Qualify confidence-gated automatic segmentation

items.title: Protect structural ROIs and screen internal drift
items.scope: Detect or explicitly route logos, seams, zipper/hardware and geometry-sensitive ROIs.
items.acceptance: Critical ROI corpus shows no confirmed construction/text/identity mutations; Sobel is a heuristic, not semantic proof; explicit overrides always win.

linear.title: F10 · Protect structural ROIs and screen internal drift

items.title: Implement colour-managed alpha and high-precision exports
items.scope: Extend current RGB8 path to deliberate ICC, orientation, alpha and real working/export precision.
items.acceptance: Colour/alpha/precision round trips and protected-pixel checks pass; no uint16 container masquerades as newly recovered detail; default grain remains off.
items.evidence: fidelis/postprocess/; current PNG export in fidelis/studio/store.py

linear.title: F11 · Implement colour-managed alpha and high-precision exports

items.title: Freeze rights-cleared corpus and comparator runners
items.scope: Build 60-case rights/hash/ROI inventory, frozen 30/30 split and reproducible comparisons.
items.acceptance: Coverage and permissions documented; each output separate; settings/cost/time/hash recorded; real comparators distinguished from unavailable evidence.
items.evidence: fidelis/eval/; experiments/eval_crops/; docs/project/QUALITY_GATES.md; explicit F12-A inventory/freeze tooling verified; production corpus and comparators remain missing

linear.title: F12 · Freeze rights-cleared corpus and comparator runners

items.title: Calibrate and pass held-out quality acceptance
items.scope: Tune on calibration cases and evaluate blind held-out results against Clarity/Krea.
items.acceptance: No critical fidelity defects; agreed threshold protocol, sample sizes/confidence intervals and category failures reported; final creative judgment recorded after concrete evidence.

linear.title: F13 · Calibrate and pass held-out quality acceptance

items.title: Deliver resumable bounded batch processing
items.scope: Persist per-image recipes and states through interrupted production batches.
items.acceptance: Batch resumes without duplicate paid work, silent data loss or unbounded memory/disk concurrency; per-item failures and retries remain visible.
items.evidence: existing native batch/audition lane; future Studio async job contracts

linear.title: F14 · Deliver resumable bounded batch processing

items.title: Polish responsive studio and verify packaging
items.scope: Complete accessible premium UI, device checks and reproducible install/upgrade/rollback.
items.acceptance: Actual M1/Android/browser checks and measured resource budgets; packaging includes intended modules/dependencies and protects saved data on upgrade/rollback.

linear.title: F15 · Polish responsive studio and verify packaging

items.title: Publish evidence-backed production release
items.scope: Close release gates and publish scope, evidence, known limits and rollback.
items.acceptance: Required quality/operational gates met, release SHA and packages linked, blocking defects closed, owner creative/release signoff recorded; merged is not automatically released.

linear.title: F16 · Publish evidence-backed production release

items.title: Evaluate optional challenger adapters after core release
items.scope: Consider FLUX/SUPIR/self-hosted challengers only for a measured quality/cost advantage.
items.acceptance: Separate compatible graph/model/terms/resource evidence; no speculative adapter expansion before the accepted core workflow.

linear.title: F17 · Evaluate optional challenger adapters after core release

items.title: Prepare a reproducible live-worker preflight
items.scope: Record an actual worker endpoint, device capability, exported workflow, runtime/node revisions and model availability without placing secrets in the repo.
items.acceptance: Doctor and workflow schema preflight run against a real reachable worker; resource owner/access and budget policy are explicit. Current executor has no worker.
items.evidence: Blocked by unavailable worker/access, not by missing fixture code.

linear.title: F05-A · Prepare a reproducible live-worker preflight

items.title: Record candidate model hashes and usage terms
items.scope: Prepare explicit candidate weight/runtime provenance and production suitability records.
items.acceptance: Real sources/revisions/weight hashes and separate terms are recorded; missing bytes or unclear terms are not represented as certified.
items.evidence: Can prepare the manifest/review before live inference.

linear.title: F05-B · Record candidate model hashes and usage terms

items.title: Build bounded async execution and ownership-safe cancellation
items.scope: Design and implement worker responsiveness, job ownership and scoped cancel against existing backend contracts.
items.acceptance: Deterministic queue/cancel/restart tests pass without globally interrupting an unrelated ComfyUI job; live acceptance remains on parent F07.

linear.title: F07-A · Build bounded async execution and ownership-safe cancellation

items.title: Add actual native image-pixel crop inspection
items.scope: Display genuine native 100/200% crops while preserving same-grid comparisons.
items.acceptance: Tests distinguish preview scale from original image pixels and verify alignment; labels are honest on mobile/desktop.

linear.title: F08-A · Add actual native image-pixel crop inspection

items.title: Complete same-host browser and target-device acceptance
items.scope: Arrange a reachable local test surface and verify pointer/touch/keyboard, masks, undo and stale saves.
items.acceptance: Actual browser/device/version, screenshots or interaction evidence and defects recorded. Do not infer visual acceptance from Node math parity.
items.evidence: Previous browser-to-executor connection was refused; use a materially different reachable test setup.

linear.title: F08-B · Complete same-host browser and target-device acceptance

items.title: Prepare corpus rights and ROI manifest
items.scope: Define and populate corpus metadata for consent/rights, categories, source hashes, known text and critical ROIs.
items.acceptance: Inventory distinguishes available cases from missing ones; proposed 60-case coverage and calibration/held-out split are frozen before tuning.
items.evidence: config/benchmark/; fidelis/eval/corpus_manifest.py; scripts/benchmark-corpus.py; tests/test_corpus_manifest.py; 8 regression assets, 0 production eligible, 60 missing slots; docs/project/checkpoints/2026-11-10-corpus-inventory.md

linear.title: F12-A · Prepare corpus rights and ROI manifest

items.title: Correct unsigned provenance reported as verified
items.scope: Legacy generate_c2pa_provenance emits signature_info.status=verified while creating an unsigned JSON sidecar. This was source-confirmed; no cryptographic verification was demonstrated.
items.acceptance: Represent unsigned execution records honestly; verified/signed status requires real signing and verification evidence; regression tests cover the unsigned case.

linear.title: D01 · Correct unsigned provenance reported as verified

items.title: Remove or repair invalid large-input pipeline import
items.scope: The use_tiling branch imports scripts.tiled_upscale, but the tracked script is named tiled-upscale.py and no scripts/tiled_upscale.py module is tracked. This is a source-confirmed import defect; no live-model reproduction was performed in this audit.
items.acceptance: A large-input pipeline test with a controlled runtime exercises the path without ImportError and preserves actual subprocess/output validation.

linear.title: D02 · Remove or repair invalid large-input pipeline import

items.title: Make local binding and deployment policy consistent
items.scope: The server default is 0.0.0.0 while the intended operating policy is local-only. Regional routes restrict clients; the inherited other routes are not an authenticated public service. Explicit loopback launch currently mitigates exposure.
items.acceptance: Default launch binds loopback unless deliberately configured otherwise; tests/docs/container boundaries are consistent; no public deployment claim without reviewed authentication/storage design.

linear.title: D03 · Make local binding and deployment policy consistent

items.title: Correct metric placeholders and pseudo-LPIPS labels
items.scope: Legacy pipeline initializes numeric quality defaults and derives a value named lpips from gradient coherence. BenchmarkSuite also passes BGR arrays into functions expecting RGB in some pipeline calls. These are source findings, not trustworthy perceptual benchmark results.
items.acceptance: Unavailable metrics remain explicitly missing; gradient proxies are labelled as proxies; colour ordering/reference semantics are correct; any real LPIPS uses its actual implementation/version; regression evidence covers failure/missing-reference paths.

linear.title: D04 · Correct metric placeholders and pseudo-LPIPS labels

milestones.name: M0 · Foundations
milestones.description: F01-F03. Exit: documented scope and tested compositor/CLI. Implementation exists in PR #12; merge/release is tracked separately.

milestones.name: M1 · Runnable two-pass alpha
milestones.description: F04-F07. Exit: persisted artifacts, checksum-verified selected base, one live GPU texture workflow, durable async execution/cancellation and no duplicate submission after uncertain outcomes. Protocol fixtures alone cannot close this gate.

milestones.name: M2 · Protected regional studio
milestones.description: F08-F11. Exit: device-accepted editable masks, confidence-gated segmentation, structural protection, colour/alpha/high-precision export. Preview zoom is not native-pixel inspection.

milestones.name: M3 · Measured quality beta
milestones.description: F12-F13. Exit: frozen calibration/held-out corpus and honest Clarity/Krea comparisons, defect report and accepted quality evidence. No unmeasured parity claim.

milestones.name: M4 · Daily production release
milestones.description: F14-F16. Exit: resumable batches, measured device resource budgets, accessible polished UI, packaging, rollout/rollback docs and evidence-backed release signoff.

milestones.name: M5 · Optional challengers
milestones.description: F17. Deferred until core release. Promote additional FLUX/SUPIR/self-hosted adapters only on a measured quality/cost win and compatible model terms.
